A1.value: WIT nickname: Candle Formation Path (CFP). Unnamed candlestick-reading method; channel/URL not captured.
A1.source_quote: It's a clue inside the candlestick that tells you when momentum is actually shifting

A2.value: Six assertions (4 testable claims about formation path, 2 untestable). claims_shown_evidence = false. Structured rows in claims[].
A2.source_quote: A candlestick can finish looking super bullish, but it can form in a way that shows you it's fake

A3.value: No arithmetic contradiction. Recorded instead: all shown examples are post-hoc selections (survivorship in the exhibits).
A3.source_quote: I'll also show you the fake out versions so you know what is real versus a fake signal

B1.value: Guru's examples show the NASDAQ index but no instrument is specified (the claim is market-agnostic). WIT tests ES as a disclosed proxy.

B2.value: Guru says any timeframe. WIT primary 5-minute (day-trading context), secondary 15-minute (better path resolution).
B2.source_quote: this can work on a one minute chart, 5 minute, any type of chart, a daily chart

B3.value: Path within a candle needs finer bars: 1-min sub-bars give 5 per 5-min candle, 15 per 15-min. No tick data; path measured on 1-min closes/extremes.
B3.assumption: Path composed from finest licensed data (1-min); approximation disclosed (WIT-02 §5, B3).

C1.value: No session rules stated. WIT restricts to RTH 09:30-16:00 ET for regime comparability.

C2.value: 'Choppy' vs bigger-picture trend is invoked as a concept but never defined numerically — no executable filter.

D1.value: No directional rule — the claim is about candle formation, not a long/short entry system.

D2.value: A 'big' bullish/bearish candle; size never quantified (partial).
D2.source_quote: if you're thinking that's just a big green candlestick

D3.value: No entry trigger — the shown trade uses a discretionary head-and-shoulders read plus a break of a high. No mechanical trigger to disambiguate.

E1.value: No sizing rule (no runnable strategy to size).

F1.value: 'Stop loss below that big candlestick' — shown once as an example, not stated as a rule (partial).
F1.source_quote: I put my stop loss below that big candlestick

G1.value: No trade-frequency limit stated; no daily setup is implied (this is not a once-a-day system).

I1.value: Guru states no optimization surface. WIT-chosen claim-codification knobs (event study): big_candle_k, path_efficiency_threshold, retrace_pct_threshold, regime_measure+threshold, forward_horizons.

J1.value: Event study (Class B). Event = RTH candle whose body >= k x rolling-median body; direction = sign of body. Path buckets Spike/Pullback/Middle from 1-min sub-bars. Regime = pre-declared chop/trend on prior bars. Outcomes: signed fwd return +1/+3/+5/+10, giveback, P(next against). Bootstrap CIs (seed 42, 10k); both timeframes.

J2.value: Interpretation set: Spike/Pullback thresholds and the regime measure are WIT codifications; every threshold gets a sensitivity row; a claim supported under only one threshold is reported fragile.

K1.value: Untestable remainder: head-and-shoulders reads, 'areas that make sense', double-top/second-attempt sequencing, the $4,000 anecdote, the PDF/funnel. No profitability verdict possible.
K1.source_quote: wait for something like this to happen of the market to make another attempt to go higher and then reverse

claims.claim: Formation path predicts follow-through vs reversal
claims.quote: A candlestick can finish looking super bullish, but it can form in a way that shows you it's fake.
if the market moves straight up with no pullbacks, even over 60 seconds, it's not going to be healthy and it's likely to give it back up
a spike higher that in a choppy environment is more likely to instantly get reversed the next candlestick
this can work on a one minute chart, 5 minute, any type of chart, a daily chart
your entries get cleaner, your stops get tighter

consistency_flags.description: No arithmetic contradiction found. Survivorship in exhibits: every example is a hand-picked chart chosen after the fact; no statistics of any kind are shown.
quotes: I'll also show you the fake out versions so you know what is real versus a fake signal

readings: body >= k x trailing-median body over N prior candles
